    a = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n+1)]
    for _ in range(n-1):
        u, v = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
        adj[u].append(v)
        adj[v].append(u)

    parent = [0]*(n+1)
    children = [[] for _ in range(n+1)]
    q = deque([1])
    parent[1] = 0

        u = q.popleft()
        for v in adj[u]:
            if parent[v] == 0 and v != parent[u]:
                parent[v] = u
                children[u].append(v)
                q.append(v)

    size = [0]*(n+1)
    sum_a = [0]*(n+1)
    def dfs(u):
        size[u] = 1
        sum_a[u] = a[u-1]
        for v in children[u]:
            dfs(v)
            size[u] += size[v]
            sum_a[u] += sum_a[v]

    max_sum = -float('inf')

        nonlocal max_sum
        if len(children[u]) == 0:
            if total > max_sum:

        print("Impossible")
